memory_candidates.content: The extension system has two distinct deploy mechanisms: (1) install-extension.sh scans the filesystem and creates symlinks - for new project setup only, skips existing non-symlinks; (2) the extension loader (Ctrl-l in extension picker) reads manifest.provides arrays and copies files with overwrite-on-confirm - the correct update path for existing projects. Use Ctrl-l when picking up new files added to manifest.provides after initial deployment.
